summary: refactor(settings): scope inline TOTP MFA guard to enrolment step
description:
Because:
- The email-OTP was demanded on page load, before the user saw the
  "set up two-step authentication" prompt.
- Guarding the intro forced an OTP round-trip even for users who never
  proceed to enrolment.

This commit:
- Move MfaGuardCore into index.tsx so it wraps only the enrolment step.
- Move InlineTotpEnrolment (JWT-guarded createTotp/verify) into index.tsx.
- Reshape InlineTotpSetup props; container becomes a sanity-check wrapper.
- Update stories and split the guard/enrolment tests into index.test.tsx.
